mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.application_id AS application_id, p.title AS product_title, p.subtitle AS product_subtitle, p.rules AS product_rules, p.price AS price, p.credits AS credits, p.valid_days AS valid_days, p.sale_mode AS sale_mode, p.application_version AS application_version, p.model_version AS model_version, p.image_size AS image_size, p.output_count AS output_count, p.status AS product_status, a.name AS application_name, a.status AS application_status FROM usage_product p JOIN ai_application a ON a.id = p.application_id WHERE p.id = #{productId} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_request(user_id, request_key, request_digest) VALUES (#{userId}, #{requestKey}, #{requestDigest}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_request SET order_id = #{orderId} WHERE id = #{requestId} AND order_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_order( user_id, request_id, product_id, application_id, application_name, application_version, product_title, product_subtitle, product_rules, model_version, image_size, output_count, credits, valid_days, sale_mode, currency, unit_price, amount, status, funding, expire_at, paid_at ) VALUES ( #{order.userId}, #{order.requestId}, #{order.productId}, #{order.applicationId}, #{order.applicationName}, #{order.applicationVersion}, #{order.productTitle}, #{order.productSubtitle}, #{order.productRules}, #{order.modelVersion}, #{order.imageSize}, #{order.outputCount}, #{order.credits}, #{order.validDays}, #{order.saleMode}, #{order.currency}, #{order.unitPrice}, #{order.amount}, CASE WHEN #{free} THEN 'PAID' ELSE 'UNPAID' END, CASE WHEN #{free} THEN 'FREE' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{free} THEN NULL ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) END, CASE WHEN #{free} THEN NOW(3) ELSE NULL END )

INSERT INTO purchase_order( id, user_id, request_id, campaign_id, campaign_generation, product_id, application_id, application_name, application_version, product_title, product_subtitle, product_rules, model_version, image_size, output_count, credits, valid_days, sale_mode, currency, unit_price, amount, status, funding, expire_at, paid_at ) VALUES ( #{order.id}, #{order.userId}, NULL, #{order.campaignId}, #{order.campaignGeneration}, #{order.productId}, #{order.applicationId}, #{order.applicationName}, #{order.applicationVersion}, #{order.productTitle}, #{order.productSubtitle}, #{order.productRules}, #{order.modelVersion}, #{order.imageSize}, #{order.outputCount}, #{order.credits}, #{order.validDays}, #{order.saleMode}, #{order.currency}, #{order.unitPrice}, #{order.amount}, CASE WHEN #{free} THEN 'PAID' ELSE 'UNPAID' END, CASE WHEN #{free} THEN 'FREE' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{free} THEN NULL ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) END, CASE WHEN #{free} THEN NOW(3) ELSE NULL END )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM purchase_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_order SET status = 'PAID', funding = 'MOCK', paid_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'UNPAID' AND amount = #{amount} AND expire_at > NOW(3)
UPDATE purchase_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', closed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'UNPAID' AND expire_at <= NOW(3)
UPDATE purchase_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', closed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'UNPAID'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM purchase_order WHERE status = 'UNPAID' AND expire_at <= NOW(3) ORDER BY expire_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO purchase_order_event(event_id, order_id, event_type, occurred_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{orderId}, #{eventType}, #{occurredAt})
